acceptance.gate: Phase 2 gate G2 per master-plan v2.1 §9: pass every (p, level) tolerance cell in pressurized-sphere-qoi.csv; target p=2 finest u_L2 <= 1e-4 and sigma_rr <= 0.5% (Coreform achieves 0.00365% / 0.211%). V01 and V02 must be re-passed with extension enabled.
acceptance.per_cell_tolerances_csv: see reference_values_csv (tolerance column, tightening with refinement)

boundary_conditions.symmetry: zero normal displacement on the three cut faces lying on the x, y, z coordinate planes (restrains rigid-body motion; octant exactly represents the full sphere)

geometry.model: one octant of a hollow sphere; cut faces on coordinate planes

materials.note: Nondimensional model: modulus and pressure set the displacement scale but cancel from the relative-error metrics.

mesh_sweep.discretization: immersed trimmed U-splines; spherical surfaces cut arbitrarily through background cells

provenance.reference_doc_sections: §2 Geometry (Table 1), §3 Material (Table 2), §4 Loading & BC (Table 3), §6 accepted Lamé solution + global L2 error evaluation, §7 Results with per-level tolerances
provenance.reference_values_csv: WHT_IGA/research-cf-IGA/user-guide/generated-downloads/verification-manual/problems/solid_mechanics/linear_elastic_stress/pressurized-sphere/pressurized-sphere-qoi.csv (columns p,level,h,quantity,rel_l2_error_vs_lame,tolerance; 45 rows incl. duplicate h=0.1 study rows)

reference_values.Lame_closed_form: c = (pi*a^3 - po*b^3)/(b^3 - a^3); kappa = (pi - po)*a^3*b^3/(b^3 - a^3); sigma_rr(r) = c - kappa/r^3; sigma_θθ(r) = c + kappa/(2*r^3); u_r(r) = (1/E)*[(1-2*nu)*c*r + (1+nu)*kappa/(2*r^2)]
reference_values.note: Coarsest-level tolerances are loose on purpose (e.g. p=1 radial stress 28.5-30.4% vs 40-45% tolerance); the gate is per-cell pass, tightening with refinement.
